The name Lisabeth carries the meaning “God's Oath to Abraham” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. It was a common name among royalty and nobility. The name's popularity can be attributed to the biblical characters Elisheba, the wife of Aaron, and the mother of John the Baptist, Saint Elizabeth.

It embodies the nurturing and caring qualities of a mother, making it a beautiful name for a child.
